name: feedback-confirm-hides-composer
for: The runtime's feedback-draft card after `2` was pressed: the key row is replaced by the send confirmation ('Send without reviewing (full draft + env, no transcript)? 2 to send · Esc to back'), which wraps at the box width and so takes one row more than the key row did. On a 24-row pane that pushes the composer's opening rule to the last row and its ❯ row off the bottom. The state read used to answer with an idle composer that is not on screen, or with an unknown that called it a full-screen interface, and every send was refused with a wording that blamed startup. This case pins that the screen reads as unknown, never idle, and never as a prompt: the confirmation is the runtime's own second guard on sending the user's data and is a person's to give, so nothing here offers it to a client. The refusal that names it is pinned in TestSendAndKeysAndRespondNameTheStateOfACardTheyCannotWriteUnder.
redactedFrom: real capture of an 80-column, 24-row pane running the runtime with drafts on, redacted by corpus-redact; the status text is kept because it is, whole, the runtime's own vocabulary, and every row of the draft above it is the agent's and is discarded
